newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel falls with futures, premiums firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel falls with futures, premiums firm.

text.p: NWE jet fuel ended lower on Tuesday as benchmark IPE futures dumped much of the past two days' gains in profit-taking, but physical premiums remained firm due to the tightness of the market, traders said.
On cargoes, fob premiums offers stood at Sept IPE +$28/+$29. Traders said very few buyers seemed willing to even contemplate these levels.

They attributed some of the tightness to new EU low sulphur rules. "The low sulphur material offers such good premiums at the moment it hardly makes sense to produce extra jet," one said. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
